verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control app, not an agent itself, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server or any agent-facing interface. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, and the docs say there is "no account and no server."

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
